messages:
Lea (People Ops): Quick heads-up — PTO accrual cadence and year-end balance guidance.

Lea (People Ops): Effective 2025-07-01 we'll change PTO accrual from monthly to biweekly (payroll-aligned). This is purely a timing change — annual accrual rates and the hard cap remain the same. The goal is fewer manual adjustments for new hires and clearer, more frequent balances. :calendar:

Lea (People Ops): TL;DR:
- Accrual frequency: biweekly (same day as payroll). Rates unchanged.
- Hard cap: stays at 240 hours.
- 2025 one-time carryover exception: up to 40 hours may be carried into 2026 if you hit the cap and can't reasonably use time off due to project constraints.
- New hires: accrual will be prorated on first biweekly paycheck; see examples in the doc.
- Unpaid leave: accrual pauses after 30 consecutive unpaid days (exceptions can be reviewed).

Lea (People Ops): What we need from you: check your current balance in the Time Off portal before 2025-12-15 if you think you'll exceed your usual usage and may need the one-time carryover. If you need an org-level exception, DM People Ops with manager sign-off.

Lea (People Ops): Details, examples, and the sign-up for the live Q&A are here: https://redwoodinference.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/PeopleOps/pages/PM-PT0-accrual-update

Sam (Engineering): Quick Q — if I'm on an unpaid parental leave for 6 weeks, does accrual stop immediately or after the 30-day window you mentioned?

Priya (People Ops): Short answer: accrual pauses after 30 days of unpaid leave. For parental leave we typically have paid leave rules that preserve accrual for the paid portion; unpaid extension follow the 30-day pause. We can review edge cases (return-to-work, phased returns) — ping me and include manager details.

Jordan (Finance): FYI payroll will run a cutover test 2025-06-15 to validate biweekly posting and the UI display. If anyone notices transient negative/incorrect balances during the week of cutover, please file a ticket to payroll@redwood with screenshots.

Tom (People Ops): We'll hold two live Q&A sessions to walk through calculations and the carryover flow:
- 2025-06-20 10:00 PT
- 2025-06-24 15:00 CET
Sign up link in the doc above. Recordings will be posted.

Sam (Engineering): 👍 will join the PT one. Thanks for the clarity.

Lea (People Ops): Appreciate it — we know this is a change in cadence, not accrual amount. We'll add a small calculator widget in the Time Off portal so you can preview biweekly accrual and projected year-end balance. DM People Ops or drop questions here if anything is unclear.
